critical_boundary: Account-user membership writes must not let ordinary users grant themselves account access. The current getAccountUserById method calls findByAccountId: the URL ID is an account ID and returns the first membership ordered by username. Authorize that account before returning membership information. Existing legacy usernames require a trusted issuer/subject mapping, not a caller-supplied username.
